name: wp-sibling-subdomain-internal-referrer
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Related-host detection is SYMMETRIC: referrer example.com visiting shop.example.com is internal (either host endsWith the other). Engine's hostMatches only checks referrer-is-subdomain-of-current.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #8): related-host detection is SYMMETRIC (either host equals or is a subdomain of the other) and external referrers must be http(s). Original note: engine's hostMatches only checked referrer-is-subdomain-of-current.
